entries.label: Morning brief
entries.text:
Today's session — 67 minutes of easy jogging:

Today’s 67 minutes of easy jogging is your chance to let your body settle into a steady rhythm—no pace pressure, just movement that builds your week’s foundation. Show up for that hour, and let each minute remind you why you started. You’ve got this.
